about: Every word on the newer screens of the website. Change a word here and the site shows it within minutes: no Lovable build, no credits. A missing key falls back to the wording built into the screen.

saved.title: Saved
saved.lead: The dances you saved, kept in this browser only.
saved.empty_dances: Tap the heart on any dance to keep it here.
saved.empty_viral: Tap the heart on any viral dance to keep it here.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Dancing Atlas is a private demonstration. It has no accounts and asks for no personal information. The dances you save stay in this browser only. Videos are played by YouTube; the dance library is read from GitHub and the Viral list from Supabase. Like any website, these services and the host of this site receive the technical information a browser sends when it loads a page.

mentor.title: A mentor that can teach anyone to dance
mentor.lead: BDF is not built yet. First it has to learn how the best teachers teach. Every night, at no cost, a machine watches the lessons that learners praise most, reads what learners write and reads the research. This page shows what it has learned so far.
mentor.unavailable: The mentor's notes could not be loaded just now. Please try again in a moment.
mentor.honesty: Machine readings, not yet checked by a person. Nothing here has been tested on learners by Dance Atlas. Every line links to the moment in the video or to the source.

dna.title: The teaching DNA
dna.lead: What a great teacher does. A rule appears here only when two or more kinds of evidence agree: teachers, learners, research.
